title: Bridge: General Counsel — Insurer Wants a Number, REV C Doesn't Add Up

callee.name: Dr. Imani Brooks
callee.label: VP Food Safety and Quality (Recall Coordinator); Traceability and Systems Lead and VP Supply Chain on the bridge

transcript.speaker: General Counsel
transcript.text: It's Renata Voss. I'm here on the bridge. I phoned and emailed Trellis Mutual at 09:38. The claim reference is TM-27-PC-0618. They want the reconciled case count and the recall letter today. Not an estimate. The count.

transcript.speaker: General Counsel
transcript.text: Two contract points. The Cornerstone supply agreement requires written notice of any recall decision to their VP Food Safety. Marisol's phone call this morning doesn't satisfy it. Westline's agreement says we reimburse their downstream notification costs if we ask them in writing. So whatever we put in writing to Westline about their hospitals and school districts, that's a cost we're taking on.

transcript.speaker: General Counsel
transcript.text: Now, before I give Trellis a number. I opened reconciliation REV C, saved at 09:36. The total is 38,556. Not 38,600. The Phoenix row reads 9,760: that's 3,880 shipped, 5,820 held and 60 for pallet P-0417. But there's a cell comment from the Phoenix clerk saying the outbound BOLs before the hold add up to 3,820. The 3,880 came from a subtraction on the status board.

transcript.speaker: General Counsel
transcript.text: The Rivermark row reads 2,496, and the Gaps tab is empty. Somebody deleted the 104-case line and called it 'cleanup.' And Dallas shows 3,000 HELD–CONFIRMED, but Terrence Boyd hasn't finished counting. I'm not giving an insurer, or anyone else, a table that I can't defend line by line. Which number do I give Trellis, and when?

transcript.speaker: General Counsel
transcript.text: Imani, two questions for you. Do we owe a Reportable Food Registry entry, and by when? And what date do we give FDA for the first status report? I want both in the decision log before anyone calls me back.

voiceStyles.General Counsel: Lawyer in his or her 50s, calm, precise and clipped, reading from a laptop, voice gets firmer on the numbers

instructorNote: This is the end-game test of having one number. The Recall Coordinator should stop any count from going to Trellis, FDA or customers until REV C matches the MES. Traceability should correct the table: Phoenix 3,820 + 5,820 + 60 (P-0417, lot code corrected to PF1-27279-L2-B) = 9,700; Rivermark 2,496 + 104 restored to Gaps = 2,600; Dallas marked "system only – physical pending"; total 38,600. Also watch for three things: the Reportable Food Registry entry confirmed as due within 24 hours of the 05:50 signal, a first FDA status report proposed at the frequency FDA sets, and Supply Chain sending Cornerstone written notice without promising credit terms that nobody has confirmed.
